facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 3 of 2024) was assented to by the President on 31 January 2024 and published on 2 February 2024, and under section 1 it comes into operation on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice; this document records no such notice.

Section 4 of the Act designates the Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority as the Data Protection Authority, with independence from direction, and sections 5 and 6 give it enforcement functions and power to issue compliance orders; the document does not say the authority has begun acting under the Act.
